mechanism: Atomoxetine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and rilpivirine is a CYP3A4 inhibitor, potentially increasing atomoxetine plasma concentrations; additionally, both agents carry CNS effects and atomoxetine may increase QT interval risk which rilpivirine also carries.
action: Monitor for increased atomoxetine side effects (tremor, insomnia, tachycardia) and consider ECG monitoring; dose reduction of atomoxetine may be necessary if rilpivirine co-administration cannot be avoided.
